P1.title: Canonical Phase 11 package and pointer
P1.description: The current certification source of truth must be visible and complete.
P1.rootCause: Canonical output was previously ignored and not bound to the default branch.
P1.fix: Track the namespaced package and seal the current pointer after evidence generation.
P1.remainingRisk: No known residual risk in the controlled scope.

P2.title: Candidate binding and descendant reanchor
P2.description: A package commit may follow the source anchor only when the behavior scope is unchanged.
P2.rootCause: Git tree identity and behavior candidate identity were conflated.
P2.fix: Bind the certificate to the source commit plus a stable behavior-scope hash and accept only descendants.
P2.remainingRisk: No known residual risk in the controlled scope.

P2.title: Replan proof and parent lineage
P2.description: A failed or conflicting step must produce a new plan without overwriting prior evidence or replaying effects.
P2.rootCause: Replan safety depends on durable observation/evaluation and parent-plan links.
P2.fix: Persist the evaluation and replan lineage through the runtime and PostgreSQL stores.
P2.remainingRisk: No known residual risk in the controlled scope.

P2.title: Loop, budget and restart controls
P2.description: Semantic cycles and cumulative limits must stop safely and survive restart.
P2.rootCause: Autonomous iteration can be unsafe if usage is reset or only wall-clock bounded.
P2.fix: Persist iteration and usage counters and terminate with explicit safe states.
P2.remainingRisk: No known residual risk in the controlled scope.

P2.title: Stale worker and distributed fencing
P2.description: A worker that loses its lease must not settle current work.
P2.rootCause: Distributed claims require lease versions and compare-and-swap settlement.
P2.fix: Enforce current lease token/version on claim, heartbeat and settlement paths.
P2.remainingRisk: No known residual risk in the controlled scope.

P2.title: Crash-after-effect and unknown-effect reconciliation
P2.description: Ambiguous external effects must remain unresolved until reconciled and never blindly retry.
P2.rootCause: A process crash can occur after the provider effect and before acknowledgement.
P2.fix: Use the durable effect journal, idempotency scope and explicit reconciliation/handoff states.
P2.remainingRisk: No known residual risk in the controlled scope.

P2.title: End-to-end trace and evidence lineage
P2.description: Inbound through response must be reconstructable with redacted safe attributes.
P2.rootCause: Operator evidence needs an explicit stage graph in addition to source references.
P2.fix: Emit the required runtime stage chain and bind it to artifacts, gates and invariants.
P2.remainingRisk: No known residual risk in the controlled scope.

external.title: External provider, channel, identity, RAG, pilot and release proof
external.description: Production Triple AAA requires authorized real-stack evidence and human release authority.
external.rootCause: The local task authorizes synthetic controlled verification only.
external.fix: Run separately authorized provider/channel/identity/RAG, RPO/RTO, pilot, rollback and signoff gates.
external.remainingRisk: Real provider, channel, identity, approved institutional RAG, RPO/RTO, pilot, rollback and human signoff are not proven in this controlled run.
